svg.text: MPx-SQ-003/006/007 · Outlet head, push-pull sleeve, dust cap
MPx Squeeze v1 · IISc CPDM · preliminary, not for manufacture
1. M32×1.0-6H 9 deep (to body); M14×1.5-6H through web (element base); M14×1.0-6g on stem (UV cap / backflush interface).
2. Push-pull: S4 (7×1.5) seals the sleeve on the stem; S8 (2.5×1.0) on the Ø4 pin closes the sleeve outlet. Pull 6 mm to open.
3. Sleeve retained by a 316L wire circlip in a stem groove at x 134.5 (bottom of the sleeve's travel).
4. Wrench flats 32 A/F on the web, 8 long. Two cross-ports Ø2.5 at 90° in the stem at 11.5 from the M14 shoulder.
